title: Y7 Logistics Dealer Account Program
subtitle: Y7 Logistics works with auto dealerships through active accounts. Complete four onboarding steps, then submit every vehicle transport request through the portal.
tldr: Y7 Logistics is a Licensed & Bonded FMCSA Broker that works with auto dealerships through registered accounts. Onboarding has four steps: enter company details, add pickup and delivery addresses, sign the agreement, and verify your email. After verification, submit transport requests through the portal. The account brings together order history, documents, milestone status, consolidated invoicing, and saved locations. One dispatcher handles the dealership's moves.

workflow.title: Open Your Dealer Account in Four Steps
workflow.requirement: A dealer account is required before Y7 Logistics can accept a transport request. No dealer license is required to open the account.
workflow.compliance: Y7 Logistics is a Licensed & Bonded FMCSA Broker. Company details identify the shipper and billing party, while the signed agreement records the broker-shipper terms needed for lawful, invoiced brokerage.

steps.title: Enter company details
steps.desc: Provide the company name and contact details used for the dealer account.

steps.title: Add your addresses
steps.desc: Enter the addresses and pickup and delivery locations your dealership uses.

steps.title: Sign the agreement
steps.desc: Review and sign the broker-shipper agreement for the account.

steps.title: Verify your email
steps.desc: Confirm the email address used to access the dealer portal.

workflow.after: After email verification, submit transport requests through the portal. The account is the booking path; transport requests are not accepted by phone.

benefits.title: What the Dealer Account Keeps Together
benefits.subtitle: The account is the operating layer for recurring dealer transport management. Behind it, Y7 Logistics assigns one dispatcher to each dealership's moves.

items.title: Orders, documents, and status
items.desc: See order history, available documents, and current milestone status in one place, so you do not need to call for every update or hunt for a BOL.

items.title: One dispatcher, not a call center
items.desc: One dispatcher handles your dealership's moves, so you do not have to explain a yard's rules or a recurring route again with every request.

items.title: Consolidated invoicing
items.desc: Multiple moves appear on one invoice for bookkeeping instead of creating a separate billing document for every vehicle.

items.title: Saved pickup and delivery points
items.desc: Saved locations stay on the account, so a repeat lane does not require re-entering either endpoint.

portal.title: Tools Available in the Dealer Portal
portal.subtitle: Beyond the core order view, the current portal supports additional account members and downloadable billing records.

features.label: Additional account members
features.desc: View the dealership users attached to the account and whether each membership is active or awaiting acceptance. Y7 Logistics adds or removes members after an email request. Every member has the same account access.

features.label: Invoices and cost reports
features.desc: Download invoice PDFs and date-range cost reports in XLSX or PDF.

features.label: Billing activity
features.desc: Review invoices and account transactions. Accounts using the carrier-payment option can also see their prepay balance and bank authorization status.

serviceOverview.body: Y7 Logistics charges a fixed per-vehicle service fee; the carrier's transport rate is separate. The service overview covers auction pickup, dealer trades, recurring lanes, current fee choices, and carrier-payment handling.

items.q: Is a dealer account required before I can book transport?
items.a: Yes. Y7 Logistics accepts dealer transport requests through active accounts, and requests are submitted through the portal after email verification. A dealer license is not required to open the account.

items.q: What are the dealer onboarding steps?
items.a: Enter your company details, add your pickup and delivery addresses, sign the broker-shipper agreement, and verify your email. After that, submit transport requests through the portal.

items.q: Why does Y7 Logistics require an account and agreement?
items.a: Y7 Logistics is a Licensed & Bonded FMCSA Broker. The company details identify the shipper and billing party, and the signed agreement records the broker-shipper terms before transport requests are submitted.

items.q: What does a dealer account include?
items.a: It includes portal access to order history, available documents and milestone status, one dispatcher for the dealership's moves, consolidated invoicing, and saved pickup and delivery points.

items.q: Will I work with a call center?
items.a: No. One dispatcher handles the dealership's moves, so recurring locations and yard instructions do not need to be explained again with each request.

items.q: Who is the dealer account for?
items.a: It is for independent used-car dealers, franchise dealers, exporter-dealers, rebuilders, and auction-focused operations. Independent dealers moving 5-30 vehicles per month are a common fit; the account setup follows the same four steps.

items.q: Where can I review transport scope and fees?
items.a: The dealer transport service overview explains covered moves, the fixed per-vehicle Y7 Logistics fee choices, the separate carrier rate, and carrier-payment handling.
